chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Be meticulous in choosing the shrouds, for they will be resurrected in them."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَكْفَانِ: burial shrouds used for the deceased

ai.seo_question: Why should one be careful in choosing a burial shroud in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs believers to take care in selecting burial shrouds. The hadith links funerary preparation with the afterlife, stating that the deceased will be resurrected in those shrouds.
